title: JSON Schema for GTDB metadata files.

accession.description: Unique genome identifier. Data from NCBI or GTDB.

ambiguous_bases.description: Number of ambiguous bases. Data from CheckM.

checkm2_completeness.description: Estimated completeness of genome using CheckM v2. Data from CheckM.

checkm2_contamination.description: Estimated contamination of genome using CheckM v2. Data from CheckM.

checkm2_model.description: Model used by CheckM v2 to estimate completeness and contamination. Data from CheckM.

checkm_completeness.description: Estimated completeness of genome. Data from CheckM.

checkm_contamination.description: Estimated contamination of genome. Data from CheckM.

checkm_marker_count.description: Number of marker genes used to estimate genome quality. Data from CheckM.

checkm_marker_lineage.description: Lineage of marker genes used to estimate genome quality. Data from CheckM.

checkm_marker_set_count.description: Number of marker sets used to estimate genome quality. Data from CheckM.

checkm_strain_heterogeneity.description: Estimated strain heterogeneity of genome. Data from CheckM.

coding_bases.description: Number of coding bases. Data from CheckM.

coding_density.description: Coding density of genome. Data from CheckM.

contig_count.description: Number of contigs. Data from CheckM.

gc_count.description: Number of GC bases. Data from CheckM.

gc_percentage.description: GC-content of genome. Data from CheckM.

genome_size.description: Size of genome. Data from CheckM.

gtdb_genome_representative.description: Indicates the representative genome of the GTDB species cluster to which this genome is assigned. Data from GTDB.

gtdb_representative.description: Indicates if a genome is the representative of a GTDB species cluster. Data from GTDB.

gtdb_taxonomy.description: GTDB taxonomy string. Data from GTDB.

gtdb_type_designation_ncbi_taxa.description: Indicates if genome is assembled from the type strain of a species or subspecies according to its NCBI classification. Data from GTDB.

gtdb_type_designation_ncbi_taxa_sources.description: Authoritative sources supporting type designation in gtdb_type_designation_ncbi_taxa. Data from GTDB.

gtdb_type_species_of_genus.description: Indicates if genome is assembled from the type species of the genus. Data from GTDB.

l50_contigs.description: L50 of contigs. Data from CheckM.

l50_scaffolds.description: L50 of scaffolds. Data from CheckM.

lsu_23s_contig_len.description: Length of contig containing selected 23S rRNA gene. Data from GTDB.

lsu_23s_count.description: Number of 23S rRNA genes. Data from HMMER w/ Barrnap HMMs.

lsu_23s_length.description: Length of single 23S rRNA gene selected from genome. Data from GTDB.

lsu_23s_query_id.description: Identifier of contig containing selected 23S rRNA gene. Data from GTDB.

lsu_5s_contig_len.description: Length of contig containing selected 5S rRNA gene. Data from GTDB.

lsu_5s_count.description: Number of 5S rRNA genes. Data from HMMER w/ Barrnap HMMs.

lsu_5s_length.description: Length of single 5S rRNA gene selected from genome. Data from GTDB.

lsu_5s_query_id.description: Identifier of contig containing selected 5S rRNA gene. Data from GTDB.

lsu_silva_23s_blast_align_len.description: Alignment length of top BLAST hit in SILVA LSU database. Data from GTDB.

lsu_silva_23s_blast_bitscore.description: Bitscore of top BLAST hit in SILVA LSU database. Data from GTDB.

lsu_silva_23s_blast_evalue.description: E-value of top BLAST hit in SILVA LSU database. Data from GTDB.

lsu_silva_23s_blast_perc_identity.description: Percent identity of top BLAST hit in SILVA LSU database. Data from GTDB.

lsu_silva_23s_blast_subject_id.description: Identifier of top BLAST hit in SILVA LSU database. Data from GTDB.

lsu_silva_23s_taxonomy.description: SILVA taxonomy of top BLAST hit for selected 23S rRNA gene. Data from SILVA.

mean_contig_length.description: Average length of contigs. Data from CheckM.

mean_scaffold_length.description: Average length of scaffolds. Data from CheckM.

mimag_high_quality.description: Indicates if genome meets the high-quality MIMAG criteria. Data from GTDB.

mimag_low_quality.description: Indicates if genome meets the low-quality MIMAG criteria. Data from GTDB.

mimag_medium_quality.description: Indicates if genome meets the medium-quality MIMAG criteria. Data from GTDB.

n50_contigs.description: N50 of contigs. Data from CheckM.

n50_scaffolds.description: N50 of scaffolds. Data from CheckM.

ncbi_assembly_level.description: NCBI assembly level. Data from NCBI.

ncbi_assembly_type.description: NCBI assembly type. Data from NCBI.

ncbi_bioproject.description: NCBI BioProject for genome. Data from NCBI.

ncbi_biosample.description: NCBI BioSample for genome. Data from NCBI.

ncbi_contig_count.description: Number of contigs. Data from NCBI.

ncbi_contig_n50.description: N50 of contigs. Data from NCBI.

ncbi_date.description: Data submitted to NCBI. Data from NCBI.

ncbi_genbank_assembly_accession.description: GenBank assembly accession.. Data from NCBI.

ncbi_genome_category.description: Genome is assembled from a single cell, metagenome, or environmental sample. Data from NCBI/GTDB.

ncbi_genome_representation.description: Indicates if genome is full or partial. Data from NCBI.

ncbi_isolate.description: Isolate name at NCBI. Data from NCBI.

ncbi_lat_lon.description: Latitude and longitude. Data from NCBI.

ncbi_ncrna_count.description: Non-coding RNA count. Data from NCBI.

ncbi_organism_name.description: Organism name at NCBI. Data from NCBI.

ncbi_refseq_category.description: NCBI RefSeq genome category. Data from NCBI.

ncbi_scaffold_count.description: Number of scaffolds. Data from NCBI.

ncbi_scaffold_l50.description: L50 of scaffolds. Data from NCBI.

ncbi_scaffold_n50.description: N50 of scaffolds. Data from NCBI.

ncbi_scaffold_n75.description: N75 of scaffolds. Data from NCBI.

ncbi_scaffold_n90.description: N90 of scaffolds. Data from NCBI.

ncbi_seq_rel_date.description: NCBI sequence release date. Data from NCBI.

ncbi_spanned_gaps.description: Number of spanned gaps. Data from NCBI.

ncbi_species_taxid.description: NCBI species taxonomy identifier. Data from NCBI.

ncbi_ssu_count.description: Number of 16S rRNA genes. Data from NCBI.

ncbi_strain_identifiers.description: NCBI strain information from the assembly report. Data from NCBI.

ncbi_submitter.description: Submitter at NCBI. Data from NCBI.

ncbi_taxid.description: NCBI taxonomy identifier. Data from NCBI.

ncbi_taxonomy.description: NCBI taxonomy string. Data from NCBI.

ncbi_taxonomy_unfiltered.description: Full NCBI taxonomy string, including non-standard or unspecified ranks. Data from NCBI.

ncbi_total_gap_length.description: Length of all gaps. Data from NCBI.

ncbi_total_length.description: Size of genome. Data from NCBI.

ncbi_type_material_designation.description: Indicates if genome is assembled from type material. Data from NCBI.
enum: assembly from heterotypic synonym type material

ncbi_ungapped_length.description: Number of ungapped bases. Data from NCBI.

ncbi_unspanned_gaps.description: Number of unspanned gaps. Data from NCBI.

ncbi_wgs_master.description: NCBI WGS accession. Data from NCBI.

protein_count.description: Number of proteins. Data from Prodigal.

scaffold_count.description: Number of scaffolds. Data from CheckM.

ssu_contig_len.description: Length of contig containing selected 16S rRNA gene. Data from GTDB.

ssu_count.description: Number of 16S rRNA genes. Data from HMMER w/ Barrnap HMMs.

ssu_gg_blast_align_len.description: Alignment length of top BLAST hit in Greengenes. Data from GTDB.

ssu_gg_blast_bitscore.description: Bitscore of top BLAST hit in Greengenes. Data from GTDB.

ssu_gg_blast_evalue.description: E-value of top BLAST hit in Greengenes. Data from GTDB.

ssu_gg_blast_perc_identity.description: Percent identity of top BLAST hit in Greengenes. Data from GTDB.

ssu_gg_blast_subject_id.description: Identifier of top BLAST hit in Greengenes. Data from GTDB.

ssu_length.description: Length of single 16S rRNA gene selected from genome. Data from GTDB.

ssu_query_id.description: Identifier of contig containing selected 16S rRNA gene. Data from GTDB.

ssu_silva_blast_align_len.description: Alignment length of top BLAST hit in SILVA SSU database. Data from GTDB.

ssu_silva_blast_bitscore.description: Bitscore of top BLAST hit in SILVA SSU database. Data from GTDB.

ssu_silva_blast_evalue.description: E-value of top BLAST hit in SILVA SSU database. Data from GTDB.

ssu_silva_blast_perc_identity.description: Percent identity of top BLAST hit in SILVA SSU database. Data from GTDB.

ssu_silva_blast_subject_id.description: Identifier of top BLAST hit in SILVA SSU database. Data from GTDB.

ssu_silva_taxonomy.description: SILVA taxonomy of top BLAST hit for selected 16S rRNA gene. Data from SILVA.

total_gap_length.description: Length of all gaps. Data from CheckM.

trna_aa_count.description: Number of standard amino acids with a tRNA. Data from tRNAscan-SE.

trna_count.description: Total number of identified tRNAs. Data from tRNAscan-SE.

trna_selenocysteine_count.description: Number of tRNAs for selenocysteine. Data from tRNAscan-SE.
